1. Topic Title: Python Essentials for Data Analysis
   Project: Implement basic data analysis functions (e.g., mean, median, mode, sorting, etc.) using built-in Python libraries

  2. Topic Title: Data Visualization with Matplotlib
   Project: Create visualizations for a dataset using scatter plots, line charts, and bar graphs in Matplotlib

  3. Topic Title: Data Manipulation with Pandas
   Project: Refactor and manipulate the structure of data using Merge, Groupby, Pivot, and Filter functions

  4. Topic Title: Intro to Statistics for Data Analysis
   Project: Conduct statistical analysis on a dataset (e.g., calculate standard deviation, correlation)

  5. Topic Title: Time Series Analysis
   Project: Analyze time-based data and create trends using Pandas and Matplotlib

  6. Topic Title: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
   Project: Clean a messy dataset by removing nulls, fixing types, and handling missing values

  7. Topic Title: Machine Learning Basics
   Project: Implement simple machine learning algorithms (e.g., linear regression) on a dataset and evaluate their performance

  8. Topic Title: Final Project - Real-World Data Analysis
   Project: Work on a real-world data analysis project, where you apply all the skills learned throughout the 8 weeks to analyze a dataset, visualize results, clean the data, and present your findings
